series.title: Gaze
series.summary: A series of black-and-white portrait close-ups that linger on eyes and the texture of skin, probing the line between openness and guard in front of the lens.

series.title: Wilderness
series.summary: Ridges, meadows and mist on uninhabited high ground, recording pure terrain under the changing light of the seasons.

series.title: Highland Pastoral
series.summary: The coexistence of pastures, cattle and people on the plateau — the daily rhythm of nomadic life.

photos.title: Lowered
photos.altText: Black-and-white half-face close-up, a woman in profile, eyes and lips in tight crop
photos.caption: Light only settles on the eyelids and the line of the lips; the rest is left to shadow.
photos.captionZh: 光线只落在眼睑与唇线上，其余留给阴影。

photos.title: Veil
photos.altText: Black-and-white close-up, a face partly veiled by falling hair
photos.caption: Hair sweeps across the forehead like a curtain deliberately left there.
photos.captionZh: 头发划过额头，像一道刻意留下的帘幕。

photos.title: Held Breath
photos.altText: Black-and-white portrait, short-haired sitter puffing cheeks, lip stud and necklace
photos.caption: A deliberate pause, halfway between a smile and none.
photos.captionZh: 一次刻意的停顿，介于笑与不笑之间。

photos.title: Sidelight
photos.altText: Extreme black-and-white close-up of a single eye and nose bridge in sidelight
photos.caption: Sidelight hands the texture of skin over to the shadows to describe.
photos.captionZh: 侧光把皮肤的纹理交给了阴影去描述。

photos.title: Wide Open
photos.altText: Extreme close-up of a curly-haired woman staring straight into the lens, eyes wide
photos.caption: The instant of looking into the lens — guard and curiosity arrive together.
photos.captionZh: 直视镜头的一瞬，防备与好奇同时出现。

photos.title: Wildflower Slope
photos.altText: Alpine wildflower meadow with snow-capped range in the distance under a deep blue sky
photos.caption: A whole hillside belonging only to the wind and flowers not yet named.
photos.captionZh: 一整片坡地只属于风和还没被命名的野花。

photos.title: Golden Plain
photos.altText: Golden meadow plain with distant snowy peaks and dramatic cloud cover
photos.caption: Low light dyes the grass the colour of metal.
photos.captionZh: 低角度的光把草地染成了金属色。

photos.title: Quiet Mound
photos.altText: Green grassy mound, an empty frame with no people or animals
photos.caption: Where there is no subject, the emptiness itself becomes one.
photos.captionZh: 没有主体的地方，留白本身成了主体。

photos.title: Ridge Line
photos.altText: Panorama of layered mountain ranges with exposed rock in the foreground
photos.caption: Each ridge is paler than the one before, until it vanishes into mist.
photos.captionZh: 每一层山脊都比前一层更淡，直到消失在雾里。

photos.title: Misty Valley
photos.altText: Misty forested valley in heavy, sombre tones
photos.caption: Mist takes back the valley's edges, leaving only outlines.
photos.captionZh: 雾把山谷的边界都收走了，只剩下轮廓。

photos.title: Lone Bull and Cabin
photos.altText: Alpine meadow, a single bull grazing beside a wooden cabin, conifer forest beyond
photos.caption: The cabin is quieter than the bull; the bull is quieter than the wind.
photos.captionZh: 木屋比牛安静，牛比风安静。

photos.title: Herd on the Slope
photos.altText: White and brown cattle grazing on a green hillside before rocky peaks
photos.caption: The slope arranges every animal into a different posture.
photos.captionZh: 坡度让每一头牛都站成了不同的姿势。

photos.title: Rest Beneath the Snows
photos.altText: Cattle resting on highland grassland with snowy mountains in the distance
photos.caption: They take the snow range as a backdrop and lie down without a care.
photos.captionZh: 它们把雪山当作背景板，毫不在意地趴下了。

photos.title: Xinjiang Pasture
photos.altText: A large herd grazing on a vast Xinjiang steppe with misty distant ranges
photos.caption: Cattle spread across the grassland like a handful of scattered seed.
photos.captionZh: 牛群铺满了整片草原，像撒出去的一把种子。
